prompt: ISO 26262: write technical requiremens for functional requirement "Operation System shall be able to switch to an economic climate mode automatically"
response: For the functional requirement that the Operation System should switch to an economic climate mode automatically, technical requirements might include: The system must monitor external temperature sensors and adjust the climate settings based on predefined economic modes. It should prioritize energy efficiency over comfort, reducing HVAC usage when possible. The system must ensure that the transition to economic mode is seamless and does not compromise safety or comfort excessively.
